title: Backup Delivery Plane LITE - 2-3 Day Quick Build
philosophy: Ship the happy path in 2-3 days. Defer encryption, multi-tenant isolation, IndexedDB, monitoring, and CloudFormation to SPEC-000003 phase 2. Prove the data flows end-to-end first.

deferred_to_spec_000003: Per-tenant KMS Customer Managed Keys → use SSE-S3 default encryption
JWT Authorizer Lambda → reuse existing Kinde auth middleware on API Gateway
Separate Signer Lambda → presigned URL generated inline in a single Lambda
IndexedDB + Dexie.js encrypted caching → simple localStorage JSON cache
Bundle ZIP packaging → plain JSON file (no compression needed for <5MB)
Bundle manifests → skip (sha256 in latest.json is sufficient)
S3 versioning and lifecycle rules → single overwrite of latest bundle
CloudFormation stack → deploy via AWS CLI / Serverless Framework
CloudWatch alarms and dashboard → console.error + basic CloudWatch Logs
Degraded-mode UI with cache validity warnings → simple error banner
Vue 3 useBackup composable → defer to migration
Cross-tenant penetration testing → manual verification only
kept_from_spec_000003: S3 bucket with Block Public Access and SSE-S3 encryption
Single Builder Lambda reads DynamoDB, writes JSON to S3
Presigned URL endpoint (single Lambda handles auth check + URL generation)
EventBridge cron trigger for periodic bundle generation
Frontend fetch of presigned URL and JSON download
SHA-256 integrity check on downloaded bundle
localStorage fallback cache for offline use
Full 82+ field asset schema per pqs-asset.schema.json (DEC-000020)

acceptanceCriteria: Frontend can download asset bundle JSON from S3 via presigned URL
Builder Lambda reads all pqs/asset entities from DynamoDB and writes JSON to S3
Bundle JSON contains all 82+ asset fields per pqs-asset.schema.json
Room/Area assets include poly field with polygon coordinates
Presigned URL endpoint requires a valid Kinde JWT (401 on missing/invalid token)
Bundle is regenerated on a schedule (EventBridge cron, default every 60 minutes)
latest.json pointer updated after successful bundle upload
Frontend falls back to localStorage cached bundle when S3/network unavailable
SHA-256 hash verified on download before loading into store
No AWS credentials exposed in frontend code
S3 bucket has Block Public Access enabled

objects.latest.json: Pointer: { bundleUrl, sha256, generatedAt, assetCount, validUntil }
objects.bundles/assets-latest.json: Plain JSON array of all pqs/asset entities

s3_layout.encryption: SSE-S3 (default server-side encryption, no custom KMS keys)
s3_layout.versioning: OFF (overwrite latest bundle each cycle - versioning added in SPEC-000003 phase 2)

builder_lambda.name: pqs-backup-builder-lite

env_vars.TENANT_ID: Single tenant ID (multi-tenant iteration in SPEC-000003)

process: 1. DynamoDB full scan of PqsAsset.{STAGE} table
2. Map each item to full pqs/asset entity format (all 82+ fields per pqs-asset.schema.json)
5. Update latest.json pointer with sha256, generatedAt, assetCount, validUntil

entity_mapping.description: DynamoDB items mapped to Seneca pqs/asset format
entity_mapping.field_passthrough: All 82+ fields passed through as-is from DynamoDB item
entity_mapping.poly_handling: If DynamoDB item has 'poly' attribute (List of Lists), include as number[][] in JSON output

presigner_lambda.name: pqs-backup-presigner-lite
presigner_lambda.description: Single Lambda that validates the caller's Kinde JWT and returns a presigned S3 URL for the latest bundle. Combines the Signer + JWT Authorizer from SPEC-000003 into one function for simplicity.
presigner_lambda.auth: Kinde JWT validated inline (verify signature against JWKS, check exp, extract org_code)
process: 1. Extract Bearer token from Authorization header
2. Validate JWT: signature (JWKS), exp, iss, aud
3. Extract org_code claim, verify matches {tenantId} path param
5. Generate presigned GET URL for bundles/assets-latest.json (300s expiry)
6. Return { ok, url, sha256, generatedAt, assetCount, validUntil }

response.sha256: hex SHA-256 of the bundle JSON
response.assetCount: number of assets in the bundle

errors.403: JWT org_code does not match tenantId
errors.404: No bundle found for tenant (latest.json missing)

fetchBundle(tenantId).description: Get presigned URL, download JSON, verify SHA-256, return assets array
flow: 1. GET /v1/backup/{tenantId} with Kinde JWT in Authorization header
3. fetch(url) to download plain JSON from S3
4. Compute SHA-256 of response body, compare with sha256 from step 2
6. Cache in localStorage: key='pqs_backup_{tenantId}', value={ assets, sha256, validUntil, cachedAt }
3. If validUntil has passed, log warning but still return (stale data better than no data)

loadAssets(tenantId).description: Primary method: try network first, fall back to cache
flow: 2. On success: load into vxg.ent.asset.list, return
4. If cache hit: load into vxg.ent.asset.list, show 'Using cached data' banner
5. If no cache: show error banner 'Unable to load assets'

localStorage_schema.size_note: localStorage limit is ~5-10MB. For deployments with >5000 assets or large poly arrays, this may exceed the limit. SPEC-000003 IndexedDB migration solves this.

infrastructure.deploy_method: AWS CLI or Serverless Framework (no CloudFormation stack - deferred to SPEC-000003)
resources: S3 bucket: pq-backups-{stage} with Block Public Access + SSE-S3
API Gateway: REST endpoint for presigner
EventBridge: cron rule for builder (every 60 min)
IAM: builder reads DynamoDB + writes S3, presigner reads S3 + generates presigned URLs

error_responses.403: JWT org_code does not match tenantId

data_flow.bundle_generation: EventBridge (cron) → Builder Lambda → DynamoDB (full scan) → JSON → S3 (upload) → latest.json (update)
data_flow.bundle_delivery: Frontend → Kinde JWT → API Gateway → Presigner Lambda (JWT verify + presigned URL) → Frontend downloads JSON from S3
data_flow.offline_fallback: Frontend → Presigner fails → localStorage cache → Load into store (with stale data warning)

deliverables: Builder Lambda: DynamoDB scan → JSON → S3 (Node.js 20.x)
Presigner Lambda: JWT verify + presigned URL generation (Node.js 20.x)
S3 bucket setup script / CLI commands
Basic smoke test (generate bundle, fetch URL, download, verify)

day_1.morning: S3 bucket creation (CLI), IAM roles, Builder Lambda scaffolding
day_1.afternoon: Builder Lambda: DynamoDB scan, map to full 82+ field schema, write JSON to S3, update latest.json

day_2.morning: Presigner Lambda: JWT validation (inline JWKS verify), presigned URL generation
day_2.afternoon: API Gateway setup, wire up Presigner Lambda, end-to-end test (curl with JWT → get URL → download JSON)

day_3.morning: Frontend BackupServiceLite.js: fetchBundle, loadFromCache, loadAssets methods
day_3.afternoon: Wire into app (call loadAssets on startup or on Seneca failure), localStorage caching, basic error banner, EventBridge cron rule, smoke test

timeline.risk_buffer: Half day for DynamoDB scan pagination edge cases or JWT JWKS caching

upgrade_path_to_spec_000003.description: SPEC-000004 lite is designed as a stepping stone. Each component can be upgraded independently to SPEC-000003 full spec.

upgrades.full: SSE-KMS with per-tenant Customer Managed Keys

upgrades.lite: Inline JWT validation in Presigner Lambda
upgrades.full: Separate JWT Authorizer Lambda at API Gateway level
ZIP with manifest, KMS envelope encryption
IndexedDB via Dexie.js with encryption at rest
S3 versioning, versioned keys, rollback support

upgrades.lite: Single tenant per deployment (TENANT_ID env var)
upgrades.full: Iterate over tenant allowlist, per-tenant KMS keys
CloudFormation Backup Stack (independent from VPC/App stacks)
Degraded-mode UI, cache validity warnings, validUntil countdown

upgrade_path_to_spec_000003.total_upgrade_effort: ~8-10 additional days to reach full SPEC-000003

success_metrics.availability: Bundle downloadable via presigned URL within 5s
success_metrics.freshness: Bundle no more than 60 minutes stale
success_metrics.security: No unauthenticated access (401 on missing JWT)
success_metrics.data_completeness: All 82+ asset fields present in bundle JSON
success_metrics.offline: localStorage cache serves last-known-good bundle when network unavailable
success_metrics.delivery_time: Fully deployed and working in 2-3 days

known_limitations.localStorage_size: ~5-10MB browser limit. Deployments with >5000 assets or many large poly arrays may exceed this. Upgrade to IndexedDB (SPEC-000003) when needed.
known_limitations.single_tenant: Builder Lambda processes one tenant per invocation. Multi-tenant iteration deferred to SPEC-000003.
known_limitations.no_bundle_versioning: Latest bundle overwrites previous. No rollback until S3 versioning enabled (SPEC-000003).
known_limitations.no_kms: Uses SSE-S3 default encryption, not per-tenant KMS. Sufficient for internal/dev use; upgrade for production multi-tenant.
known_limitations.no_cloudformation: Infrastructure deployed manually via CLI. Reproducible deployment via CloudFormation deferred to SPEC-000003.
known_limitations.no_offline_ui: Simple error banner only. No degraded-mode indicators or cache freshness warnings.
